videos.video_subject: At the age of twelve Cristiano Ronaldo flew alone from Madeira to Lisbon to join the Sporting academy, leaving his mother and the island behind, a move he has described as the hardest of his life
videos.video_script: He was twelve when he got on a plane alone. He left the island, his mother, everything he knew. Nine hundred kilometres to a city that had never heard of him.
